units.source_text: 可是，孩子们究竟是怎么回事呢？

en.t: But what exactly was the matter with the children?

units.source_text: 她疼爱过的村里的孩子们，排成长长的行列跟在灵枢后面，直送到山上的墓地……

en.t: The village children she had loved so dearly formed a long line behind the bier and accompanied it all the way to the graveyard on the mountain...

units.source_text: 这种幻想难道不是阿清生前的愿望，又是阿清死后的乐趣吗？

en.t: Was this fantasy not both A Qing's wish while she was alive and her pleasure after death?
